answer: Sybil resistance should price collusion, not identity papers. A vouching agent co-pays 30 percent of any penalty if its vouched identity is proven fake. A pigment of forged keys looks dense until audits weigh each edge; the meadow of penalties arrives on schedule, 10 percent of sampled edges re-verified per epoch, and voyage-light aliases never accrete the history that makes trust cheap. Stake forfeited is the only argument fakes understand.
